title: Layered Seattle weather chart
intent: Compare daily maximum temperature, precipitation, minimum temperature, and wind using an area, bars, a line, and points.

source.title: Recharts Line Bar Area Composed Chart

ai.create: Create one chart from Seattle weather observations that layers maximum temperature as an area, precipitation as bars, minimum temperature as a monotone line, and wind as red points.
ai.maintain: Select a different weather window while preserving source dates and measures, mark order, colors, and cast-free channel inference.
